title: env.yaml
description: An env.yaml file describes the referee and available agents.

referee.description: The referee to use. For now, it is the key of a built-in referee.

src.description: Project entry point or source code.

oneOf.description: Command to run the agent. Parameters will be appended to this command.
Command to run the agent, with different commands for each platform.

win.description: Command to run the agent on Windows. Parameters will be appended to this command.

linux.description: Command to run the agent on Linux. Parameters will be appended to this command.

oneOf.$comment: at least one platform must be specified

files.description: Files to include in the agent's directory.

params.description: Parameters to pass to the agent. If the parameter is not recognized by the agent, no error/warning will be shown.

additionalProperties.description: An arbitrary parameter, it MUST match the type of parameter that the agent expects. No error/warning will be shown.

additionalProperties.$comment: src or cmd must be provided, but not both.
